    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def segments(n, seps):
    out=[];s=0
    for p in seps+[n]:
        out.append(list(range(s,p)));s=p+1
    return out

def mark_pairs(grid, sep_color, marker_color, one=1):
    fr=[i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if set(r)=={sep_color}]
    fc=[j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(r[j]==sep_color for r in grid)]

    rb=segments(len(grid),fr); cb=segments(len(grid[0]),fc)
    return [[one if sum(grid[r][c]==marker_color for r in rs for c in cs)==2 else bg for cs in cb] for rs in rb]

open(p+'/lib.py','a').write('''
def full_rows(grid, color):
    """Indices of rows that are one color throughout."""
    return [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if set(row) == {color}]

def full_cols(grid, color):
    """Indices of columns that are one color throughout."""
    return [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[j] == color for row in grid)]

def segments(n, seps):
    """Index lists of the runs between separator positions (0..n-1)."""
    out, s = [], 0
    for p in list(seps) + [n]:
        out.append(list(range(s, p))); s = p + 1
    return out

def count_blocks(grid, sep_color, marker_color):
    """Counts of marker_color cells in each block between full sep_color rows/cols, as a matrix."""
    rb = segments(len(grid), full_rows(grid, sep_color))
    cb = segments(len(grid[0]), full_cols(grid, sep_color))
    return [[sum(grid[r][c] == marker_color for r in rs for c in cs) for cs in cb] for rs in rb]

def block_count_map(grid, sep_color, marker_color, match_count=2, hit=1):
    """Per-block matrix: hit where the block contains exactly match_count marker cells, else the background."""
    counts = count_blocks(grid, sep_color, marker_color)
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (sep_color, marker_color)).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[hit if v == match_count else bg for v in row] for row in counts]
''')
